# §14 test matrix

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs:matrix` from `src/tests/scenario-map.ts`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every scenario the specification lists in §14, with the named test that covers it.
`src/tests/test-matrix.test.ts` fails if any reference below stops existing — the table
cannot drift away from the code.

| # | Requirement | Covered by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | The extension installs and opens | `tests/e2e/extension.spec.ts` → _1. the extension installs, registers a service worker and opens the editor_ |
| 2 | A new drawing can be created | `tests/e2e/extension.spec.ts` → _2 + 3. a drawing can be created, shapes drawn, then undone and redone_<br>`src/tests/repository.test.ts` → _saves and reopens a drawing without losing element data_ |
| 3 | Shapes can be created and edited | `tests/e2e/extension.spec.ts` → _2 + 3. a drawing can be created, shapes drawn, then undone and redone_<br>`tests/e2e/milestone2.spec.ts` → _templates: using one creates an editable drawing with real elements_ |
| 4 | Undo and redo work | `tests/e2e/extension.spec.ts` → _2 + 3. a drawing can be created, shapes drawn, then undone and redone_<br>`tests/e2e/milestone3.spec.ts` → _10 + 11. valid AI output previews, inserts as editable shapes, and undo restores_ |
| 5 | Drawings autosave and reopen correctly | `tests/e2e/extension.spec.ts` → _5. drawings autosave and reopen after a reload_<br>`src/tests/autosave.test.ts` → _commits the newest revision and reports saved state_<br>`src/tests/reliability.test.ts` → _survives ten debounce cycles without losing or duplicating a write_ |
| 6 | Multiple drawings remain separate | `tests/e2e/extension.spec.ts` → _6. multiple drawings stay separate_<br>`src/tests/repository.test.ts` → _keeps drawings separate_ |
| 7 | Import rejects invalid files safely | `tests/e2e/library.spec.ts` → _7. importing an invalid file shows an error and creates nothing_<br>`src/tests/archive.test.ts` → _rejects a file that is not an archive_<br>`src/tests/archive.test.ts` → _rejects an archive containing a corrupt drawing, importing nothing_ |
| 8 | PNG and SVG exports work | `tests/e2e/extension.spec.ts` → _8. PNG export produces a real image file_<br>`tests/e2e/extension.spec.ts` → _8b. SVG export produces sanitised vector output_<br>`tests/e2e/extension.spec.ts` → _8c. JSON export is a valid, re-importable document_ |
| 9 | AI output passes schema validation | `src/tests/ai-validate.test.ts` → _accepts a well-formed diagram_<br>`src/tests/ai-validate.test.ts` → _never throws for adversarial payloads_ |
| 10 | Invalid AI responses do not corrupt drawings | `tests/e2e/milestone3.spec.ts` → _10. an invalid AI payload is rejected instead of corrupting the drawing_<br>`src/tests/ai-validate.test.ts` → _fails cleanly, with an actionable message, on garbage_ |
| 11 | AI failure preserves existing content | `tests/e2e/milestone3.spec.ts` → _11. a failed generation reports the problem and leaves the drawing byte-identical_<br>`src/tests/ai-provider.test.ts` → _returns an error, not a broken plan, when the model replies with prose_ |
| 12 | AI credentials can be configured and removed | `tests/e2e/milestone3.spec.ts` → _12. AI settings can be configured, tested and removed_<br>`src/tests/ai-provider.test.ts` → _masks keys for display_ |
| 13 | Browser capture handles permission failures | `tests/e2e/milestone4.spec.ts` → _13. a protected page is refused with honest copy, not a silent failure_<br>`tests/e2e/milestone4.spec.ts` → _13. capture without a grant explains what to do instead of hanging_<br>`src/tests/capture.test.ts` → _reports a denied permission as copy, not as a raw Chrome string_ |
| 14 | Storage errors produce actionable messages | `src/tests/autosave.test.ts` → _surfaces a failed save and retries the pending revision_<br>`src/tests/reliability.test.ts` → _recovers cleanly from a failed save and reports it exactly once_ |
| 15 | Keyboard shortcuts do not interfere with text editing | `tests/e2e/milestone2.spec.ts` → _shortcuts: the sheet opens with "?" and never fires while renaming_<br>`src/tests/a11y-keyboard.test.ts` → _never lets a shortcut fire while text is being entered_ |
| 16 | Light and dark themes work | `tests/e2e/extension.spec.ts` → _16. the theme toggle switches the editor between light and dark_<br>`tests/e2e/milestone2.spec.ts` → _settings: theme choice applies immediately and persists_<br>`src/tests/a11y-contrast.test.ts` → _computes known ratios correctly (guards the maths itself)_<br>`src/tests/ui.test.tsx` → _applies the resolved theme to the document root_<br><sub>Colour contrast for both themes is asserted numerically by the a11y suite.</sub> |
| 17 | Core drawing features work offline after installation | `tests/e2e/extension.spec.ts` → _17. no request ever leaves the extension while drawing and exporting_<br>`tests/e2e/milestone5.spec.ts` → _17. every surface loads with zero external requests_ |
| 18 | Chrome permissions match the documented requirements | `scripts/check-build.mjs` (`permissions match PERMISSIONS.md`)<br>`src/tests/permissions.test.ts` → _declares exactly the documented permissions_ |
